items.heading: Kasknoepfle
details: Key ingredients: flour dumplings, cheese, fried onion
Make a soft dumpling batter from flour, eggs and water.
Press small dumplings directly into boiling salted water.
Layer the cooked dumplings with plenty of grated cheese, letting it melt.
Top with crispy fried onions before serving.

items.heading: Ribel
details: Key ingredients: corn meal, milk, butter, sugar
Toast corn meal in butter until lightly golden.
Add milk gradually, stirring to avoid lumps.
Cook, stirring, until the mixture turns crumbly and dry.
Serve warm, sweetened lightly, often with stewed fruit.
